title: Flames of Love
summary: A tourist is found shot dead in a bathroom. It seems like a suicide because she's leaning against the door and holding the gun.
method: The killer was let in to the bathroom by the victim and proceeded to shoot her through a pillow, muffling the noise. He then wiped the prints off the gun and placed it in the victim's hands. The killer then connected his phone to audio equipment at the beach and set a timer to play a gunshot and set off on a run. The gun belongs to the hotel manager, and he knew where it was because he was snooping through the office the day earlier.
motive: The killer was controlling, and was upset that the victim cheated on him and broke up with him.
notes: This is the first episode with Martha.
